evidence: The precursors used to deposit Pd thin films were Pd(II) hexafluoroacetylacetonate (Pd(hfac)2) and formalin. Ultra high purity nitrogen (Airgas, 99.999%) was used as the carrier gas. The ALD timing sequences can be expressed as t1-t2-t3-t4 where t1 and t3 are the exposure times for the two precursors and t2 and t4 are the nitrogen purge times between precursor exposures.
